requirements.note: Creates the Lead row with customer_name, mobile_number, email, city, source, product='Private Car' and status=LeadStatus.NEW.
Sequential scan over all leads for a non-Lost/non-Converted match on mobile_number + vehicle_registration_number; register_lead raises DuplicateLeadError (409) when one is found.

Keeps lead.status == Capture and risk.is_complete == False while any of REQUIRED_RISK_FIELDS is missing; the response lists missing_fields and no further node is reachable from capture until it is True.
_evaluate_decline_rules and _evaluate_refer_rules are checked in a fixed order with an early return on first match; no human-review step is inserted between capture and this automatic screening.
On a decline match, lead.status is set to LeadStatus.LOST with lost_reason set; a Lost lead is excluded from 'converted' and 'open' counts in compute_counts_conversion.
outcome == 'Declined' sets risk.decline_reason = 'Underwriter declined' and lead.status = LeadStatus.LOST with that same lost_reason.

Reads RiskRepository.latest_approved_for_lead, rates via the one rate_card.rate_risk formula, stores a new Quote row (rated_at, expires_at = end of day 7, breakdown fields) and sets lead.status = QUOTED; record_underwriter_outcome chains into it automatically on approval with no added review step (process_graph edge record_underwriter_outcome->auto_rate_quote).

Computes own-damage (Comprehensive only) = idv * own_damage_rate * (1 - no_claim_bonus_fraction), a flat third-party premium for Third Party, applies loading_percent on the pre-loading total, and rounds the stored total via round_to_nearest_rupee (ROUND_HALF_UP to the integer rupee).

Only inserts a new Activity row (date/time via occurred_at, agent_id, channel, outcome, note, optional next_follow_up_date); no router anywhere in the service exposes PUT/PATCH/DELETE for an activity, verified by the 405 test.

Re-invoking on an already-Quoted lead creates version = len(existing)+1 and flips every prior Active quote to Replaced; validate_bind_inputs/bind_and_issue_policy only ever read QuoteRepository.latest_for_lead, so a replaced/expired/declined version can never be bound.

client_decision_wait handles decline (records price/bought_elsewhere/not_interested reason, sets Lost) and accept (reports quote status for bind); maybe_expire_quote is invoked at the start of both client_decision_wait and validate_bind_inputs and sets lead.status=Lost with lost_reason='Quote expired' once datetime.utcnow() passes quote.expires_at, with no human choosing it.

_generate_policy_number issues a unique 'PC-{calendar year}-{six digits}' number; the Policy row stores coverage_type, idv, premium_breakdown (own/third-party/loading/NCB/total), no_claim_bonus_amount, loading_amount and effective_date from the accepted quote, and lead.status becomes CONVERTED.

Rejects (ValidationFailedError, 422) when effective_date < today or > quote.expires_at.date(), or when collected_amount != quote.total_premium; only on success does it chain to bind_and_issue_policy via process_graph.run_transition.

Raises ConflictError (409) when lead.status is CONVERTED or LOST; otherwise reassigns lead.agent_id to a different active agent without touching status or the Activity table (test_reassign_open_lead_keeps_status_and_activities asserts the activity count and status are unchanged).

role='agent' scopes to LeadRepository.list_by_agent(agent_id); role='underwriter' scopes to list_referred(); role='manager' returns list_all() and additionally chains to compute_counts_conversion. The agent/underwriter/manager action routes (activities, decision, reassign, counts) are separate endpoints already gated by their own business rules.

Computes assigned/open/converted/lost per agent and for the agency by filtering LeadRepository.list_all() live on every call; conversion_rate = converted/assigned (0.0 when assigned is 0), never a stored or hand-entered value.
